pillar_reactions.evidence: Straightforward agreement during delivery — 'Yeah, definitely' and 'No, I think I'm good there. That makes sense.' He came back to the theme unprompted a few minutes later and tied it to himself, which is the closest he came to enthusiasm: 'we all want to look good, but we want to feel good too... I want to feel like I move better mobility and just feel like I'm not hurting just to move around.' That was the moment the back issue surfaced and it was not picked up.

Interrupted the pillar to check the mechanics of what was being asked of him — 'Yeah, I would say, I mean, in that aspect, well, I mean, are you asking me, or do I need to answer that right now?' The rep clarified it was a general point rather than a live question. He had already volunteered that nutrition was an active project: 'right now I'm trying to focus on, you know, diet as well. So I'm trying to work on a meal prepping.'

Volunteered the strongest positive reaction of the call to this pillar — 'Yeah, this has been well thought out, man.' He had also pre-named the need before the pillar was delivered: 'I know myself, I operate a lot better when I have someone giving me instructions and I have a game plan in front of me. But when it's just myself, you know, things can fall through the cracks.' This was the pillar he bought.

anchors.raw: I've actually followed his content for a while and used a lot of his workouts on my own. Nice. mean, I feel like it's a good system, good structure, and I want to jump in with it.
anchors.competitor: Trevor's own free social content and workouts
anchors.note: Unusual case where the free substitute drove the sale rather than blocking it — extended exposure had already built trust and he converted without price resistance. Recorded because the risk is latent rather than absent: he is paying $6,000 for structure around workouts he has been doing free, and nobody ran the 'so why can't you stick to it on your own' question that would have made the distinction explicit and durable.

anchors.raw: With my wife, I think we have a great relationship, but she's kind of in the same boat where she's, you know, wanting to get back into yoga, know, make fitness more of a, more of a priority. So just kind of keeping each other accountable in that way.
anchors.note: The household was already reallocating toward fitness, so no partner objection ever formed. Contrast with the two calls in this batch where a spouse arrived unannounced after the price and had to be worked around.

anchors.raw: I feel like I've gotten to a good point in my career to where, you know, things have settled down as much as not, you know, I'm not so much nose to the grindstone at the office. So I feel like I have more time now to where I can focus on myself.
anchors.note: He arrived at a self-declared inflection point with time and money freed up simultaneously. This is what an unforced close looks like and it is the clearest illustration in the batch of timing doing the work the consequence frame usually has to do.

unmet_demand.want: Training that resolves rather than aggravates back problems from old sports injuries — 'that's my big thing. I want to feel like I move better mobility and just feel like I'm not hurting just to move around'
unmet_demand.why_unmet: He named it as his big thing and it was met with a generic line about being designed to be fluid. No question about what the injury is, how long it has persisted, whether it has been assessed or whether loaded ballistic kettlebell work is appropriate for it. Whether the programme serves this is genuinely unknown to both parties.

unmet_demand.want: A gradual on-ramp calibrated to his current conditioning — 'I probably should gradually ease myself into it, especially with my conditioning where it is. But that's a part of just having someone who can give me a better plan of kind of easing myself into it'
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The baseline audit and tailored programme almost certainly deliver exactly this, and the rep described the mechanism, but never connected it back to the burnout pattern the prospect had just described. The single most reassuring thing that could have been said to this prospect was available and unsaid.
